move.subject: Re: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for explaining your position.

Our data shows a different picture on some points:
Our bottom-up cost model puts the full cost of this part at EUR 24.31 per unit (cost:340010).
Your rolling scorecard shows on-time delivery of 79.5% (sc:70410@2026Q3).
Our demand forecast for this part has risen 10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09).

Please find 3 packages below. Each of them works for us; let us know which one suits you best.

We look forward to your reply.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the delivery record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your cost model and the increased volume forecast. Our calculation is our property; we do not share a breakdown.

A reduction in lead time to 42 days or fewer necessitates a substantial price premium due to our high capacity utilisation. Which volume can you commit to? Our Angebot stands at a price of €33.60 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 42 days. Alternatively, with Lieferzeit 54 days: a price of €31.70 per unit, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We acknowledge your commitment to 23,400 units per year over 24 months. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our Angebot stands at a price of €31.40 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. Our offer stays valid for 7 days.

In response to your improved offer for a 42-day lead time, we adjust our price to €33.20 per unit, with terms of a price of €33.20 per unit, Lieferzeit 42 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, a contract term of 24 months. Our high capacity utilisation restricts further concessions for this lead time. 

Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Which volume can you commit to?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
